scripts.deploy: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');let N=0;try{N=parseInt(cp.execSync('git rev-list --count HEAD').toString().trim())||0}catch(e){}let c='';try{c=cp.execSync('git rev-parse --short HEAD').toString().trim()}catch(e){}const v='1.'+Math.floor(N/10)+'.'+(N%10);require('fs').writeFileSync('public/version.json',JSON.stringify({version:v,commit:c,date:new Date().toISOString()}))" && npx --yes wrangler deploy
